author: vanilla70012
quote: So, I've heard a lot of people say this game is like RDR2, and that it's slow just like RDR2. Here's the thing, Arthur has personality, even though he's a quiet guy, he has personality and even Sadie, if you compare her to Lucia - her story makes sense. She becomes who she is after she loses everything that she has in life. In GTA 6, the story is really bland, like the characters don't have any personality. It's pretty much a sims game, the story is beyond mid, you just simp out of your mind for girl named Lucia just because the main character has no personality himself nor any fun friends so he just runs around for Lucia to get him a good entertaining life. It's pretty much just girlfriend boyfriend simulator
